package clusterstore
import ("testing";"context";"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/trace";"github.com/stretchr/testify/require";"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/wkdb";"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/cluster/replica")
func TestMigrationHistoricalConfigApplyKeepsEncodedVersion(t *testing.T) {
 trace.SetGlobalTrace(trace.New(context.Background(),trace.NewOptions(trace.WithServiceName("migration-history"),trace.WithServiceHostName("local"))))
 db:=wkdb.NewWukongDB(wkdb.NewOptions(wkdb.WithDir(t.TempDir()),wkdb.WithShardNum(2)))
 require.NoError(t,db.Open());defer db.Close()
 s:=&Store{wdb:db}
 cfg:=wkdb.ChannelClusterConfig{ChannelId:"synthetic-history",ChannelType:2,ReplicaMaxCount:3,Replicas:[]uint64{1001,1002,1003},LeaderId:1001,Term:1,MigrateFrom:1001,MigrateTo:1001,ConfVersion:1732364897806218890}
 data,err:=cfg.Marshal();require.NoError(t,err)
 payload,err:=EncodeCMDChannelClusterConfigSave(cfg.ChannelId,cfg.ChannelType,data);require.NoError(t,err)
 command,err:=NewCMD(CMDChannelClusterConfigSave,payload).Marshal();require.NoError(t,err)
 require.NoError(t,s.onMetaApply([]replica.Log{{Index:305,Term:1,Data:command}}))
 stored,err:=db.GetChannelClusterConfig(cfg.ChannelId,cfg.ChannelType);require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,cfg.ConfVersion,stored.ConfVersion)
 require.Equal(t,cfg.MigrateFrom,stored.MigrateFrom);require.Equal(t,cfg.MigrateTo,stored.MigrateTo)
 require.Equal(t,cfg.Replicas,stored.Replicas);require.Empty(t,stored.Learners)
}
